title: Half-Moon
summary: H'ALF-MOON, noun The moon at the quarters, when half its disk appears illuminated. 1. Any thing in the shape of a half-moon In fortification, an outwork composed of two faces, forming a salient angle,

inlines.v: H'ALF-MOON, noun The moon at the quarters, when half its disk appears illuminated. 1. Any thing in the shape of a half-moon In fortification, an outwork composed of two faces, forming a salient angle, whose gorge is in the form of a crescent or half-moon
